title: How to Wash a Football Kit: The Ultimate 10-Step Guide for Optimal Care
meta_title: How to Wash a Football Kit: 10 Steps to Keep It Perfect | MOMUTO
meta_descript: Discover the ultimate 10-step guide to washing and caring for your football kit. Expert tips to protect prints, colours and fabric on all kit types.
content:
Now that you have learned how to customise your football kit, it is essential to know how to care for it in order to preserve its quality and vibrancy. A football kit, beyond being a simple garment, is a symbol of belonging and passion. To ensure its longevity, you need to know the right washing techniques. Here is a complete guide to caring for all types of kits, from classic MOMUTO designs to official shirts and replicas.

Understanding the different types of kits:

The first step to an optimal wash is recognising what type of kit you have.

  • MOMUTO kits: Our fully customisable kits use sublimation technology. Thanks to this technique, they stand out for their increased resistance to repeated washing. Sublimation allows the ink to penetrate directly into the fabric, guaranteeing vivid colours that stand the test of time.
  • Official kits:
    • Player Version: These kits, designed for on-pitch performance, are made from lightweight materials and feature heat-pressed logos. They are perfect for playing but require extra care when washing.
    • Stadium/Fan Version: Designed for everyday fan use, their durability comes from embroidered logos and badges, offering greater resistance.
  • Replicas: These vary greatly in quality. While more affordable, they may require special care due to the variability in printing quality.

1. Wash your kit inside out

Turn your kit inside out to protect the prints and colours from intense friction. This is a pro tip for keeping patterns looking vibrant.

2. Choose a cold wash

High temperatures can damage the fabric. By keeping it at 30°C, you preserve the integrity of the kit.

3. Use the right detergent

Bleaching agents are the enemy of colour. Opt for a liquid detergent designed for coloured fabrics.

4. Skip the fabric softener

Fabric softener, while making the fabric feel soft, damages technical fibres and can alter colours.

5. Avoid spin drying

Vigorous spinning can cause damage. Allow the kit to drip dry naturally.

6. Air dry only

The heat from a tumble dryer can shrink the fabric and damage the prints.

7. Always iron inside out

Direct heat from an iron can damage designs. A useful tip is to place a thin cloth between the iron and the kit.

8. Never dry clean

The chemicals used in this process can be too harsh for the kit.

9. Take extra care with delicate prints

Some prints, particularly lower-quality ones, require extra precautions. Where possible, wash by hand.

10. Wash after every use

Sweat and dirt accelerate fabric wear. A post-match wash ensures its longevity.

Conclusion:

A well-maintained kit reflects the passion and respect a fan or player has for their team. By following these expert recommendations, your kit will remain in perfect condition, ready for every match or fan meet-up.
